code:
|Respo Markdown component renders Markdown text to virtual DOM in Respo. Require the code with

```cirru
:require
  respo-md.comp.md :refer $ comp-md comp-md-block

comp-md "|content"

comp-md-block "|content\nnew line" $ {}
```
